explanation: Evidence never provides IC50=11nM, Ki=2nM, 'first-in-class' status, antiestrogen-combination synergy/senescence data, or Rb-deficient/Rb-dependent activity claims. Only supported facts are: in vitro G1-to-S blockade in ER+ cells and Rb dephosphorylation as PD biomarker.
